title: Label record
description: One rater's judgment of one item in one run (issues #16, #53). Written by the labeler, skeptic, open-coder or context-classifier and stored by record_label (#14). Shape only: checks that need the database (category in codebook, item exists, quote found in the skill, run matches) are in scripts/validate_label.py. Run-level provenance (model, temperature, codebook version id) lives on the run; prompt_hash is added by the provenance logger (#35).

schema_version.description: Bump when this schema changes incompatibly.

run_id.description: runs.run_id. The run fixes the rater, model, temperature, sample and codebook.

item_id.description: skill: file_sha (git blob hash, 40 hex). repo: owner/name.

codebook_version.description: vNN of the codebook applied. null only for open coding (Round 0), where labels are free-form codes.

skill_language.description: Language of the skill text as stored in skill_language (#52), e.g. 'en', 'zh'. Required for skills.

labels.description: The categories that apply, each with its evidence. Empty only when the record proposes a new category instead.

proposals.description: PROPOSED_NEW: categories the rater suggests because nothing in the codebook fits. Humans accept, merge or reject them.

allOf.description: A record must say something: at least one label or one proposal.
Skills carry a 40-hex file_sha and their language; repos carry owner/name.
Purpose labels skills; context labels repos.
With a codebook, labels are codebook keys (slugs) and new ideas go in proposals. Open coding has no codebook, so proposals make no sense there.

quote.description: Verbatim from the item, in its original language (#53). Must occur in the skill text.

quote_en.description: English translation of quote; identical to quote when the skill is English (#53).

category.description: Codebook key, or a free-form open code when codebook_version is null.

definition.description: What the category covers, in English.

justification.description: Why no existing category fits. Always in English (#53).
